Alex: Heads up I opened a focused PR to add an offline proxy example for Private installs, plus a short PKCS#11 placeholder section. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2629
Maria: Nice. Could we keep the example minimal for customers who run a single-hop egress proxy? A tiny curl check and port list would help.
Alex: Planning to include an egress sanity checklist: ports, cert trust, proxy chaining note.
Jia: I'll paste a minimal nftables rule and a sample env file for the proxy. Keep the PKCS#11 lines template-only.
Jia: nftables (bullseye tested):
```
# allow proxy -> hsm range on TCP 23456 and management 8300
add table inet redwood_egress
add chain inet redwood_egress input { type filter hook input priority 0; policy drop; }
add rule inet redwood_egress input ct state established,related accept
add rule inet redwood_egress input ip saddr 10.50.0.0/24 tcp dport {23456,8300} accept
```
Jia: proxy env sample (.env):
```
PROXY_LISTEN=0.0.0.0:8080
TARGET_HSM=10.50.0.12:23456
TLS_CA=/etc/redwood/ca.pem
PKCS11_SLOT="<SLOT_PLACEHOLDER>"
```
Sam: For air-gapped installs, include the offline CA import steps for Debian and Alpine. Also add a note: if customers use sni-proxy chaining, make sure to preserve original SNI header for HSM termination.
Sam: Debian CA import: `sudo cp ca.pem /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ && sudo update-ca-certificates`
Sam: Alpine: `sudo cp ca.pem /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ && sudo update-ca-certificates` (same path but ensure openrc service restart)
Tess: Editorial: normalize HSM uppercase in headings and prefer "egress proxy" over "proxy" in section titles. Also flag any examples that include ARNs or real slot IDs.
Alex: Will scrub sensitive identifiers and standardize headings. Also adding a tiny curl healthcheck: `curl -v --resolve hsm:23456:10.50.0.12 https://hsm/health` to illustrate host override in airgapped setups.
Maria: Can you add a micro migration note for customers upgrading from installer v0.x to v1.x where the proxy binary moved? A one-liner note is enough.
Alex: Adding: "v0.x -> v1.x: move /opt/redwood/bin/egress-proxy -> /usr/local/bin/redwood-egress-proxy, preserve /etc/redwood/proxy.env"
Jia: Add systemd snippet to keep proxy alive and a log rotation hint:
```
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redwood-egress-proxy --config /etc/redwood/proxy.env
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
LimitNOFILE=65536
```
And: /etc/logrotate.d/redwood-proxy -> rotate 7
Sam: CI found one dead link in docs/private/install.md -> anchor '#egress-chain' missing. (DocsBot)
DocsBot: CI: linkcheck failed -> docs/private/install.md '#egress-chain' not found (job #831)
Alex: Adding the anchor and a brief paragraph describing SNI header preservation and when to use TLS passthrough vs termination.
Maria: Please include a short troubleshooting checklist: tcpdump on host, check nftables rules, verify CA in trust store, systemd status for proxy, and curl with --resolve.
Jia: I'll add a 5-step checklist and a small annotated tcpdump command: `sudo tcpdump -n -i any port 23456 and host 10.50.0.12`
Tess: Security note: remove any example that suggests embedding private keys in the env file. Recommend use of KMS/HSM-backed secrets or file permissions 600.
Alex: Replaced env key example with TLS_KEY_PATH and added permission guidance (chmod 600). Also added backport to release/1.2.x for customers on older installers.
DocsBot: CI: linkcheck passed, linter warnings only.
Maria: Happy to review final wording, will watch for the SNI paragraph.
Alex: Pushed final fixes. Ready to merge after Maria review.
Maria: Reviewed and LGTM.
DocsBot: PR merged and backported to release/1.2.x. Thread closed.
